name: Requires Package
description: This package needs this package: the dependency link an SBOM lists (CycloneDX dependencies[].dependsOn), between two packages the same document lists. A reference, not containment: a dependency outlives the package that named it. Never drawn from a package to itself, and not drawn to a library, a program or a component the document does not list. The document records that the link exists, not whether it is a build-time, run-time or optional dependency.
